name: docker-lint
description: Flags Dockerfile smells: :latest tags, running as root, apt without cleanup, ADD instead of COPY.

ignore.title: Ignored rules
ignore.description: Comma-separated rule ids to skip: latest-tag, root-user, apt-recommends, apt-cleanup, apt-update-alone, add-local, curl-pipe, secret-name.

useHadolint.title: Use hadolint
useHadolint.description: Run hadolint when it is installed and report its findings in place of the built-in rules it covers.
